social.text: The Vertigo effect 🎥 Also called the dolly zoom or Hitchcock zoom: the camera physically moves toward or away from the subject while the lens zooms the opposite way. The subject stays the same size, but the background stretches or compresses. Popularised by Hitchcock’s Vertigo (1958). Best used sparingly, for a moment of shock, dread or realisation. # Cinematography # Filmmaking # DollyZoom # VertigoEffect # FilmTechnique
